subject: Operational resilience: request for BCP/DR artifacts (RTO/RPO)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@fintechcorp.com
Date: 2026-09-13T16:15:00-07:00
Subject: Operational resilience request - BCP/DR artifacts for inference platform

Hi Jasmine,

We're updating our vendor resilience review for our Q4 audit and need a concise package covering Redwood's business continuity and disaster recovery for the inference platform. Specifically, could you provide the following by COB Tuesday, 2026-09-14: 

- A short RTO and RPO statement for the hosted inference API and Dedicated mode (per-region if applicable)
- Excerpt of your DR runbook showing the failover decision tree and nominated runbook owners
- Most recent RTO test summary (date, scope, observed recovery times)
- Current continuity policy version and controls that relate to data persistence and KV cache recovery
- Primary on-call and escalation contact for DR events (name + phone/email)

If there are known gaps or scheduled remediation work that would affect RTO/RPO within the next 30 days, please call that out. We can accept PDFs/Excel summaries or a shared Drive link.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
FintechCorp

Date: 2026-09-14T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: plan for FintechCorp BCP package

Jasmine / Laura — here is a quick assembly plan so we can hit Liam's COB request: 

- I will produce the RTO/RPO statement for Hosted API + Dedicated (US primary) and include quantified numbers (target RTO 3 min for control-plane failover, RPO <1 min for active KV cache with fallback to prefix cache). File: redwood_rto_rpo_statement.pdf
- Laura, can you extract the DR runbook excerpt (decision tree + runbook owners) and redact any internal pager numbers; put in dr_runbook_excerpt.pdf
- I will pull the last scheduled failover test (2026-06-18) and generate rto_test_summary_2026-06-18.xlsx with timings and lessons learned
- Jasmine, please include continuity_policy_v2.1.pdf (customer-facing section only) and confirm whether we should add a short gap note on the planned quantization rollout next month that may change cold-start behavior for some Dedicated configurations
- I'll upload everything to the Drive folder and attach PDFs to the outbound email.

Risk/gap note for the submission: the quantization rollout scheduled for mid-October may increase cold-start latency for some Dedicated GPUs prior to the new kernel landing. That is accounted for in our planned remediation (scheduled kernel update and additional warm-up slots). We should call this out as a known item with mitigation timeline.

Attachments (planned): redwood_rto_rpo_statement.pdf, dr_runbook_excerpt.pdf, rto_test_summary_2026-06-18.xlsx, continuity_policy_v2.1.pdf

Dev
